capabilities: Import selected BiliNote notes and screenshots into a vault folder
Automatically import new completed BiliNote results on a timer or at vault open
Recover moved or renamed imports from frontmatter for deduplication
Share screenshot files between BiliNote and the vault via hard links
Delete downloaded audio/video files from BiliNote's cache after import
disambiguation: Despite the name, it is not two-way sync; it imports BiliNote results into the vault and does not sync your edits back to BiliNote.
extras: The settings interface is Chinese only. The plugin is not yet published in the community directory; manual installation steps are given. The optional media cleanup permanently deletes cached audio/video files without a trash bin, and the README warns to keep it disabled while other programs modify the cache. Only Windows has been tested; macOS and Linux are untested.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to import the notes and screenshots that the BiliNote desktop app produces, so users must copy files by hand.

relations.evidence: BiliNote is a separate dependency; its code and executable are not bundled.

summary: Filesystem importer that brings notes and screenshots generated by a local BiliNote installation into a desktop Obsidian vault.
